title: Npgsql
description: The .NET data provider for PostgreSQL, supporting advanced PostgreSQL features.

data.text: Npgsql is the .NET data provider for PostgreSQL. It allows .NET applications to connect to and interact with PostgreSQL databases, supporting advanced features like arrays, JSON, and full-text search.

data.title: Connecting and Querying
data.content: Connect to PostgreSQL and execute a query.

terms.definition: The .NET data provider for PostgreSQL, implementing the ADO.NET interfaces.
Represents a connection to a PostgreSQL database.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use `NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder` to safely construct connection strings.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Npgsql is the standard PostgreSQL provider for .NET
data.takeaway: Npgsql provides robust PostgreSQL connectivity for .NET applications.

data.description: Connect to PostgreSQL using Npgsql and retrieve data.
